title: Accuracy of Goldreich–Levin stage records
statement: Let the input specify an output dimension $n>0$, a positive rational accuracy at most $1/2$, and an integral Fourier $1$-norm bound $s\ge1$. Let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube whose Fourier $1$-norm is at most $s$. For every $k<n$ and every finite family $A$ of coordinate subsets, each estimate record produced at stage $k$ differs from the corresponding restricted Fourier weight of $f$ by less than one quarter of the square of the learning threshold specified by the input.
hypotheses_covered: twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
Fourier bound $s$ is at least one
target is a sign-valued function on the sign cube
active family is a finite family of coordinate subsets
